svg.aria-label: A stop, step by step. 1, the containers to bring back are noted first, so a stop cut short still brings them back. 2, your hooks in /etc/wsl-spawner/pre-stop.d run in the order of their names. 3, the systemd units /etc/wsl-spawner/stop-units names stop, ordered by their dependencies. 4, Docker's daemon stops every container itself, each with its own stop timeout, and keeps their restart policies. 5, Podman's containers stop, each with its own timeout. 6, the journal and the disk are synced and the stop's record says how it ended: clean, limit or failed. All the steps share stop_limit, 300 seconds by default; then WSL ends what is left.
